commands: cd src && MAVEN_OPTS=-Xmx2g mvn -B -Pfastinstall -DskipTests -pl core -am package
notes: Reactor: cxf (root pom), cxf-parent, cxf-core (project version 4.1.1-SNAPSHOT). -Pfastinstall is the project's own profile (maven.test.skip, pmd.skip, checkstyle.skip, invoker.skip). The build itself generates the ws/addressing, wsdl/http and configuration/security classes (cxf-xjc-plugin) and packages the module's resources; the build plugins under the org.apache.cxf group (cxf-xjc-plugin, cxf-xjc-dv, cxf-buildtools, cxf-xml2fastinfoset-plugin) are separate Apache projects resolved from Central and not on the fixture's class path. The jar has the same entries as the cxf-core 4.1.0 release (847 classes). Fixed: cxf-core 4.1.1.
